svg.title: Measured folded-sheet placement across a finite receiving edge
svg.desc: Upward table force and lowest sheet skin from 2.8 to 4.3 seconds. The left case rests. The center loses contact and falls. The right case depends on contact resolution.

g.text: Folded sheet on the finite receiving edge
Table force is averaged over 10 ms. Weight is 82 mN. The axes clip forces above 130 mN and falls below −100 mm.
